title: Guttmann-Flury et al. 2025 (Motor Imagery) — Dataset combining EEG, eye-tracking, and high-speed video for ocular activity analysis across BCI paradigms
description: A multimodal brain-computer interface dataset combining EEG, eye-tracking, and high-speed video recordings from 31 healthy participants performing motor imagery tasks. The dataset comprises 2,520 trials across 63 sessions using a 64-channel EEG system with synchronized ocular activity monitoring, designed to investigate the relationship between eye movements and motor imagery performance across multiple BCI paradigms.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired at 1000 Hz using a 64-channel Neuroscan Quik-Cap with SynAmps2 amplifier, referenced to the right mastoid with forehead ground. The system recorded 66 total channels (64 EEG + 1 EOG + 1 stim). Participants performed two-class hand motor imagery tasks (left and right hand grasping) with visual rectangle cues, 40 trials per session across up to 3 sessions. Concurrent eye-tracking and high-speed video recordings captured ocular activity during imagery execution.
